  Zero Hour-the author's own!
  That moment of breathless anticipation just be-
fore the dawn of a new adventure; a new dream's
reality. To the world-the hour when all nature
seems stilled; all living things, motionless, await-
ing the dawn. Or perhaps that moment of ominous
quiet before the crash of cannon and high shriek
of shell quicken exhausted senses to the stark
reality of war. To the author the moment that
comes at last; after a long night of toil; of weav-
ing elusive dreams into the fabric of a book!
Hushed interval, bringing with it the welcome
hint of daw11ing as the author catches breath and
sighing, says, ''Now, my task is done! Soon, with
the coming dawn, my book will have its little day.
If only it may cast a beam of light-not shadow-
across the Dial of Life, I am content.''

richest colors and array her table likewise. Riot-

sunshine in the room, glowing through draperies
